 LISA has dropped her new single “ Tarantino ” along with a music video inspired by the classic movies of director Quentin Tarantino . 
 The K-Pop star has included the song on her new EP Press Play , which features six songs created with a movie in mind, so fans can sit down and “press play.”
 In the new music video, Lisa goes on an action-packed journey to deliver a note to Tarantino , who she says is her favorite director. 
 LISA’s “Tarantino” lyrics revealed
 The lyrics to the new song make references to Tarantino ‘s famous movies like Kill Bill and Death Proof . 
 She sings in the chorus, “Got my nails really long like the barrel of my gun / And my lipstick all over your face / I’m a boss, I’m a don when I’m drivin’ to the sun / It’s a movie, baby, come and press play (Press play) / Tarantino, Tarantino / Got my feet hangin’ out the Camino (Oh).”
 You can read the full lyrics below. 
 Read “Tarantino” by LISA on Genius 
 LISA ‘s new EP Press Play also features the songs “ SaWaDiKa ,” “V12,” “Cobra,” “Cut U Off,” and “Sweat.”
 “This EP is about my journey from my roots to where I am right now today. There’s a lot of Thai elements in the songs as well, in the EP. And every single song has their own character, their own vibe and we combine it together. It’s like a movie. So you just press play,” she said on Fallon .
